title: vl06: Postulat 2 'positiver Operator rho mit tr(rho) = 1' without the trace-class condition in infinite dimension

legacy.old_text: Das ist ein positiver Operator $\rho$ auf $\mathcal{H}$, mit $\tr(\rho) = 1$.
legacy.gap_tjo: Kern stays finite-dimensional (D22 as written); Vertiefung c04.v1 states that density operators are the positive trace-class operators with trace 1, that they are exactly the normal states, and that non-normal states exist (gap G-0003).

reason: Hazard H4.1: in infinite dimension 'trace 1' needs the trace class, and the positive normalised functionals on B(H) strictly contain the density operators (normal states); BR I Theorem 2.4.21 (c04.thm.normal) and c04.ex.singulaer.
notes: Lecture 5/6 round (docs/plan/lec56/BRIEF.md, 2026-11-04): applied in the German script v0.3 rewrite of chapters 5 and 6 and in the course; status stays 'recorded' until the English edition follows and the rewritten chapters are pinned in a script snapshot (then 'applied' with the applied_* fields).
